storylines.title: Iran War
storylines.overview: The Iran War is a sustained international conflict centered on Iran, the United States and Israel, with military, maritime, economic and diplomatic consequences across the Persian Gulf and neighboring states. U.S. combat operations began on February 28, 2026, and security in the Strait of Hormuz has remained one of the conflict's central pressure points.
storylines.current_status: In a significant escalation, Russia launched one of its largest aerial attacks on Ukraine, resulting in at least eight fatalities. During this assault, missiles reportedly struck Poland, with officials in Warsaw confirming that at least one missile landed on NATO territory, which Poland described as a provocation. In response, world leaders have expressed their support for Poland amid the unfolding situation.
